rules.name: Immutable Anomaly Logging
rules.statement: The system must append every operational anomaly to a cryptographically secured, immutable audit log that cannot be altered or deleted.
rules.condition: when an operational anomaly occurs during order preparation, allocation, or fulfillment
rules.if_violated: The business faces regulatory fines, legal liability, and loss of trust due to inability to prove compliance
rules.rationale: Regulatory authorities require a tamper-proof record to verify adherence to labor and food safety laws during investigations

parameters.name: retention_period
parameters.description: duration the immutable log must be preserved

rules.name: Anomaly Status Transition Validation
rules.statement: A status transition for an anomaly record is valid only if the new status logically follows the previous status in the defined lifecycle.
rules.condition: when an anomaly record changes state from one lifecycle stage to another
exceptions: manual override by a designated Compliance Officer with dual authorization
rules.if_violated: The audit trail becomes unreliable, leading to potential rejection of compliance evidence by regulators
rules.rationale: Logical consistency in state changes ensures the integrity of the root cause analysis timeline

rules.name: Anomaly Resolution Evidence Linking
rules.statement: An anomaly record may only be marked as 'Resolved' if it is linked to verifiable evidence proving the issue was addressed.
rules.condition: when an operator attempts to change an anomaly status to 'Resolved'
rules.if_violated: False closure of anomalies hides recurring risks and violates food safety or labor law mandates
rules.rationale: Proof of resolution is essential for accurate root cause analysis and regulatory compliance

parameters.name: evidence_types
parameters.description: list of acceptable evidence formats (e.g., photo, signature, timestamped log)

rules.name: Regulatory License Anomaly Escalation
rules.statement: The system must automatically escalate an anomaly related to a Store Partner's license expiration to a Compliance Officer if the expiration date is within 30 days.
rules.condition: when an anomaly is detected regarding a Store Partner's license validity
rules.if_violated: The business risks accepting orders from unlicensed partners, leading to severe legal penalties
rules.rationale: Proactive management of license anomalies prevents illegal operations and ensures continuous regulatory compliance

parameters.name: escalation_threshold_days
parameters.description: number of days before expiration triggering escalation
